> Hi! I think I will probably have to take another look at the PR to fully understand the uses of this new class. So far, I only have a question: I assume there is a good reason for this, but I wonder... why did you choose not to wrap `Number`s into non-dimensional `np.array`s from the start? I feel like this could simplify the code, but I probably don't have clear enough vision of how numpy works in these cases.

Thanks for raising this! I am actually no longer aware of why I tried so hard to achieve this.. :thinking:  I just pushed a commit to revert this and see how this goes. This is actually what we were already doing in the `PolynomialTensor`, too :+1:
